gsc/rules/army_rules/Cult Ambush/text:
Army Faction GENESTEALER CULTS
Start of battle: Resurgence points by battle size
- Incursion: 6
- Strike Force: 10
- Onslaught: 14

Timing: each time a unit from your army is destroyed
Condition: every model in that unit (excluding CHARACTER models) has this ability
Result: may spend Resurgence points, number set by that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models)
If spent:
- new unit added to your army, identical to the destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, all wounds remaining, any [ONE SHOT] weapons of those models considered not shot
- one Cult Ambush marker placed anywhere on the battlefield >9" horizontally from all enemy units (none placed if not possible)

Units in Cult Ambush
Cult Ambush: a type of Strategic Reserves
Units in it: cannot be targeted with the **Rapid Ingress** Stratagem
Set up on the battlefield: using a Cult Ambush marker (below), or by the Strategic Reserves rules in a subsequent turn
Not automatically destroyed at end of the third battle round

Cult Ambush markers
Marker: circular, 32mm diameter
Enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT) ends any kind of move ≤8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed: that marker removed from the battlefield
End of your opponent's next Movement phase: for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, may select a unit from your army in Cult Ambush to make an ingress move
That ingress move: unit set up with at least 1 model in base contact with that marker, all other models wholly within 3" of it; marker then removed from the battlefield
Units in Cult Ambush: may make an ingress move in the first battle round using this rule
